authority_statement: The files under candidate/v7-migration and their bound public supplements remain authoritative. This package projects them for presentation and does not recalculate or reinterpret the evaluation.

calculation_disclosure.aggregate_score_source: The completed, validated V6-to-V7 migration bound by the final receipt.
calculation_disclosure.dimension_gates_and_caps: Applied according to subject-index-dimension-calculation-v3; gates remain separate claim restrictions.
calculation_disclosure.displayed_locator_language: A displayed locator is one delivered page reference or continuous range. A range is audited as multiple atomic page assignments but counts as one displayed locator for scanning and subdivision review.
calculation_disclosure.page_reference_reliability_source: The complete frozen locator-credit ledger, combined with unchanged expected-treatment recall under the V7 calculation profile.

gate_status.effect: An applicable failed gate prevents an unqualified publication-ready claim but does not secretly change the arithmetic score.

gates.finding: All 5,338 atomic locators resolve to existing, in-scope labels 1-425; none is fabricated, nonexistent, or out of scope.

gates.description: systematic incidental or unsupported locator pattern
gates.finding: The full audit finds 463 unsupported assignments (8.67%) distributed across every one of the 17 chapters.

gates.description: central subject or conclusion materially omitted
gates.finding: Twelve of 155 frozen essential subjects are missing, so central material is materially omitted.

gates.description: heading reverses or seriously misrepresents source stance
gates.finding: Three structure defects are explicitly classified as major stance failures, and the full node review records additional major conceptual failures.

gates.description: compound heading locators support only separate components
gates.finding: One major compound-heading defect has locators that do not support the combined relationship expressed by the complete path.

gates.description: see source replaces a warranted substantive entry
gates.finding: The serfdom see-reference substitutes broad targets that do not retrieve the frozen subject treatment for the alternate lookup term.

gates.description: unresolved, self-referential, circular, or chained cross-reference
gates.finding: Two see-also references terminate at unresolved displayed targets; graph review finds no self-reference, cycle, or chained see reference.
All 1,904 heading nodes are at level one or two; no third-level headings occur.

gates.description: systematic named-entity, example, or citation clutter
gates.finding: The full locator audit records 235 attribution-only or incidental-example access points across all 17 chapters, a systematic clutter pattern.

No critical or major grounding item remains unresolved. Seven localized, high-confidence locator/benchmark dependency conflicts were retained without reinterpretation and disclosed for centralized adjudication.

gates.description: more than 1% of in-scope locator assignments uninspectable without a frozen alternative tolerance
gates.finding: All 5,338 assignments were inspectable; the uninspectable rate is 0%, below the frozen 1% tolerance.
The frozen page map and 17-chapter manifest cover supplied document pages 1-425 exactly once, and every candidate locator resolves within that span.
The canonical outputs are structurally complete: 1,904/1,904 nodes, 16/16 references, 5,338/5,338 locators, and 1,366/1,366 benchmark subjects are present and uniquely graded.

item_grades.disclosure: V7 locator grades equal 100 times the frozen combined locator credit and are non-additive. They are not averaged to reconstruct Page-reference Reliability; the canonical calculation uses locator_utility_assignments[].combined_credit. Editorial Selectivity remains separate.

details.zero_metric_rule: a metric value of zero receives 0/5

limitations: The result applies only to the identified 2002 source edition and the evaluated published-index representation.
The counterfactual is secondary and changes only the explicitly documented representation assumptions.
Canonical supporting item detail comes from the public V7 item-assessment artifact; no separate adjusted item-assessment artifact is projected.
Editorial judgments are evidence-based but can differ at the margins; stable IDs and provenance make disagreements inspectable.
Density targets are this framework’s calibration points, not universal indexing standards or quotas.
The repository excludes source PDFs, restricted ledgers, private migration inputs, and recovery material; this projection does not attempt to reconstruct them.
